title: The podcast boom
paragraphs: Do you prefer to watch TV or listen to the radio? There was a time when some people thought moving pictures beamed live into our houses would spell the end of tuning in to the radio for entertainment and information. But radio survived and flourished. And now, despite the growth in sophisticated smartphones offering high-definition pictures, the popularity of podcasts is booming.

Perhaps the growth in podcasting is not surprising – it offers a digital audio file that can be downloaded and stored for listening at any time. It can also be streamed from the internet and played on a computer or MP3 player. And it’s not just broadcasters, like the BBC, who are producing podcasts: now commercial broadcasters, individuals and companies with no connection to broadcasting are making them. In fact, anyone with something to say, and a few pounds to spend on the equipment, can get involved.

But where did this trend for making portable audio programmes begin? Journalist Ben Hammersley told the BBC that “two changes transformed the market – one cultural and one technical.” Apple launched the iPhone podcast app, recording and editing equipment became cheaper, and 4G mobile phone connections and Wi-Fi became widespread. Technological development has driven many changes in our media consumption habits. But however good the tech may be, there still needs to be something worth watching or listening to. The BBC’s Jamie Robertson writes that for podcasts, Serial - a piece of non-fiction investigative journalism – captured people’s imagination. It was a piece of high-quality audio with a gripping story. To date, the first and second seasons of the show have had more than 340 million downloads. Advertisers soon realised the money-making potential of this and other successful podcasts.

Now there are podcasts about anything and everything - even the educational content that BBC Learning English offers! And these aural treats are available on a wide range of platforms. Audiences are very specific, which can help advertisers target what they want to promote. And if there isn’t a podcast to suit your interests, you can now easily make and distribute them - and become your very own broadcaster.

vocabulary.entry: podcast /ˈpɒdkɑːst/ n. 播客（数字音频节目）
vocabulary.example: I listen to a technology podcast on my commute.
vocabulary.translation: 我通勤时会听一档科技类播客。

vocabulary.entry: beam live /biːm laɪv/ 实时传输；现场直播
vocabulary.example: The concert was beamed live to audiences around the world.
vocabulary.translation: 这场音乐会向全球观众进行了实时直播。

vocabulary.entry: spell the end of /spel ði end ɒv/ 意味着……的终结
vocabulary.example: The rise of online shopping may spell the end of some traditional stores.
vocabulary.translation: 网购的兴起可能意味着一些传统商店的终结。

vocabulary.entry: tune in /tjuːn ɪn/ 收听（广播）；收看（电视）
vocabulary.example: I tune in to the news every morning at 7 o’clock.
vocabulary.translation: 我每天早上7点收听新闻。

vocabulary.entry: flourish /ˈflʌrɪʃ/ v. 繁荣；兴旺
vocabulary.example: The local restaurant has flourished since it changed its menu.
vocabulary.translation: 这家本地餐厅更换菜单后生意日益兴旺。

vocabulary.entry: sophisticated /səˈfɪstɪkeɪtɪd/ adj. 先进的；精密的
vocabulary.example: This is a sophisticated piece of computer software.
vocabulary.translation: 这是一款先进的计算机软件。

vocabulary.entry: high-definition /ˌhaɪ ˌdefɪˈnɪʃn/ adj. 高清的；高分辨率的
vocabulary.example: We bought a high-definition TV for watching movies.
vocabulary.translation: 我们买了一台高清电视用来观影。

vocabulary.entry: boom /buːm/ v. 迅速发展；繁荣
vocabulary.example: The tourism industry is booming in this region.
vocabulary.translation: 该地区的旅游业正在迅速发展。

vocabulary.entry: digital audio file /ˈdɪdʒɪtl ˈɔːdiəʊ faɪl/ 数字音频文件
vocabulary.example: The singer released her new song as a digital audio file.
vocabulary.translation: 这位歌手将新歌以数字音频文件的形式发布。

vocabulary.entry: stream /striːm/ v. 流媒体播放；在线播放
vocabulary.example: We can stream the concert directly from the internet.
vocabulary.translation: 我们可以直接从网上流媒体播放这场音乐会。

vocabulary.entry: commercial broadcaster /kəˈmɜːʃl ˈbrɔːdkɑːstə(r)/ 商业广播公司
vocabulary.example: The programme is produced by a leading commercial broadcaster.
vocabulary.translation: 这档节目由一家顶尖商业广播公司制作。

vocabulary.entry: portable audio programme /ˈpɔːtəbl ˈɔːdiəʊ ˈprəʊɡræm/ 便携式音频节目
vocabulary.example: Portable audio programmes are popular among people on the go.
vocabulary.translation: 便携式音频节目深受忙碌人群的喜爱。

vocabulary.entry: recording and editing equipment /rɪˈkɔːdɪŋ ənd ˈedɪtɪŋ ɪˈkwɪpmənt/ 录音编辑设备
vocabulary.example: The studio has invested in new recording and editing equipment.
vocabulary.translation: 该工作室购置了新的录音编辑设备。

vocabulary.entry: media consumption habits /ˈmiːdiə kənˈsʌmpʃn ˈhæbɪts/ 媒体消费习惯
vocabulary.example: Young people’s media consumption habits have changed with the internet.
vocabulary.translation: 互联网的发展改变了年轻人的媒体消费习惯。

vocabulary.entry: non-fiction investigative journalism /ˌnɒn ˈfɪkʃn ɪnˈvestɪɡətɪv ˈdʒɜːnəlɪzəm/ 非虚构调查类新闻
vocabulary.example: The book is a work of non-fiction investigative journalism about environmental issues.
vocabulary.translation: 这本书是一部关于环境问题的非虚构调查类新闻作品。

vocabulary.entry: capture people’s imagination /ˈkæptʃə ˈpiːplz ɪˌmædʒɪˈneɪʃn/ 吸引人们的兴趣
vocabulary.example: The artist’s unique style captured people’s imagination.
vocabulary.translation: 这位艺术家独特的风格吸引了人们的兴趣。

vocabulary.entry: gripping /ˈɡrɪpɪŋ/ adj. 扣人心弦的；引人入胜的
vocabulary.example: It’s a gripping novel that you can’t put down.
vocabulary.translation: 这是一本扣人心弦的小说，让你欲罢不能。

vocabulary.entry: to date /tuː deɪt/ 至今；到目前为止
vocabulary.example: To date, we have received over 500 applications.
vocabulary.translation: 至今，我们已收到超过500份申请。

vocabulary.entry: money-making potential /ˈmʌni ˈmeɪkɪŋ pəˈtenʃl/ 盈利潜力
vocabulary.example: 这款新应用具有巨大的盈利潜力。
vocabulary.translation: The new app has great money-making potential.

vocabulary.entry: aural treat /ˈɔːrəl triːt/ 听觉盛宴
vocabulary.example: The classical music concert was an aural treat.
vocabulary.translation: 这场古典音乐会是一场听觉盛宴。

vocabulary.entry: specific audience /spəˈsɪfɪk ˈɔːdiəns/ 精准受众；特定受众
vocabulary.example: The podcast targets a specific audience interested in history.
vocabulary.translation: 这档播客的目标受众是对历史感兴趣的特定人群。

vocabulary.entry: distribute /dɪˈstrɪbjuːt/ v. 发布；分发
vocabulary.example: The company plans to distribute the new software next month.
vocabulary.translation: 该公司计划下个月发布这款新软件。
